mapper.sql: eom.mapping_id as "mappingId", eom.user_id as "userId", u.login_id as "loginId", coalesce(kps.name, u.login_id) as "userName", eom.organization_code as "organizationCode", o.organization_name as "organizationName", eom.business_type as "businessType", eom.data_scope as "dataScope", eom.change_reason as "changeReason", eom.updated_by as "updatedBy", eom.updated_at as "updatedAt"
mapper.select:
select from evaluation_organization_mappings eom join users u on u.user_id = eom.user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no join organizations o on o.organization_code = eom.organization_code
order by eom.business_type, eom.organization_code, eom.user_id limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
select count(*) from users where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and system_use_yn = 'Y'
select count(*) from organizations where organization_code = #{organizationCode} and status = 'ACTIVE' and system_use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_organization_mappings (user_id, organization_code, business_type, data_scope, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{userId}, #{organizationCode}, #{businessType}, #{dataScope}, #{changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (user_id, organization_code, business_type) do update set data_scope = EXCLUDED.data_scope, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason})
